name: Milestone Birthday
tagline: For the big 30, 40, 50 and 60: stories, toasts and guesses about the guest of honour.

cards.text: You've reached {age}, {name}! Everyone share one lesson they're glad they learned by your age (or wish they had).
What's the best birthday tradition you've ever heard of? Should {name} adopt it?
Give {name} one piece of advice for the next decade. Make it practical or make it wise.
What's one thing {name} should try for the first time this year?
Share a book, hobby or habit that changed your life and why {name} might love it too.
What's the best decision you made in your {age}s (or the one you're looking forward to)?
Recommend one trip {name} should take before the next milestone birthday.
What's the best compliment you've ever received? Now give one to {name}.
Guess {name}'s favourite year of their life so far. {name} reveals the answer.
Guess the first concert {name} ever went to — or the first music they owned. Genre counts!
Guess {name}'s dream job at age seven. Closest answer wins.
Guess what {name} would do with a completely free Saturday. {name} judges.
Guess {name}'s go-to comfort meal. Everyone answers on three.
Guess which decade {name} would live in if they could time-travel. {name} explains.
Guess the most spontaneous thing {name} has ever done. {name} reveals the truth.
Guess {name}'s biggest bucket-list item. Anyone close gets a round of applause.
Guess {name}'s favourite way to spend a birthday: big party, quiet dinner or adventure?
Guess the skill {name} would learn if they had unlimited time.
Would you rather relive your best birthday or get a preview of your next one?
Would you rather have a surprise party every year or plan one epic party every decade?
Would you rather get a handwritten letter from everyone here or one amazing group gift?
Would you rather go back and give your teenage self one tip or ask your 80-year-old self one question?
Would you rather spend the next birthday on a mountain or on a beach?
Would you rather have a cake that's too big or a playlist that's too long?
Would you rather learn a new language or a new instrument this year?
Would you rather have your birthday be a national holiday or have a star named after you?
Tell the room how you met {name}. {name} rates the accuracy out of 10.
Share your favourite memory with {name} from the last ten years.
Tell a story about {name} that shows exactly who they are.
What's the best birthday you've ever had? What made it great?
Describe {name} in three words, then explain the most surprising one.
What's something {name} taught you, maybe without realising?
Share a time {name} made you laugh until you couldn't breathe.
If {name}'s life so far were a book, what would chapter one be called?
In 30 seconds, list {age} things you're grateful for. How far do you get?
Sing "Happy Birthday" to {name} in the style of an opera singer. The room scores you.
Recreate {name}'s signature move, phrase or laugh. {name} judges.
Give a 20-second speech about why {name} is great. No pauses allowed!
Mime {name}'s favourite hobby. First to guess picks the next player.
Invent a new holiday in {name}'s honour — name it and describe one tradition.
Name ten things that were different when {name} was born. 30 seconds!
Give {name} a new superhero name and describe their power in one sentence.
On three, point at who has known {name} the longest. Are you right?
Point at the guest most likely to throw {name}'s next party.
Who here is most like {name}? Point now!
Point at the person who gives the best gifts in this room.
Who would {name} call first in an emergency? Point — then {name} settles it.
Point at the guest who'll still be dancing at midnight.
Who in the room has the best birthday story? Point — they must tell it.
Point at who's most likely to remember everyone's birthday without a reminder.
Quick-fire: name something invented in the year {name} was born or after. Pause and you're out!
Quick-fire: say one word that describes {name}. No repeats.
Quick-fire: name a birthday cake flavour. Last one standing picks the next card.
Quick-fire: name a place {name} has lived, worked or travelled. Go round until someone blanks.
Quick-fire: name a party game. Go!
Quick-fire: name something that gets better with age.
Raise a glass: finish the sentence "Here's to {name}, because…"
Toast the next {age} years — make one wish for {name}.
Toast {name}'s family and friends — the people who make every year better.
Make a toast to {name}'s best decision of the last decade.
Toast an adventure you want to share with {name} this year.
What should {name} stop worrying about at {age}? Everyone answers in five words or fewer.
Guess what {name} wanted to be when they grew up — and whether they secretly still do.
If you could give {name} one memory back to relive, which would you choose?
